description: This file is a shell script that contains functions for managing Git worktrees related to pull requests, including operations like entering a worktree, retrieving PR metadata, listing, and cleaning up PR worktrees.

methods.name: repo_root
methods.description: Determines and returns the canonical repository root directory, resolving common git directory paths to handle linked worktrees.

methods.name: enter_worktree
methods.description: Sets up and switches to the specified pull request's worktree, fetching the latest data from the remote repository.

methods.name: pr_meta_json
methods.description: Retrieves detailed metadata about a pull request using the 'gh' CLI tool and outputs it as JSON.

methods.name: write_pr_meta_files
methods.description: Stores the PR metadata JSON and extracts key fields into environment variables for later use.

methods.name: list_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Lists all existing PR worktrees and their statuses.

methods.name: gc_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Cleans up closed or merged PR worktrees, optionally in dry-run mode.

methods.name: pr_number_from_worktree_dir
methods.description: Extracts the pull request number from a worktree directory name.
